description: 0/0 at x=0 combining sin x factoring with the half-angle limit (1-cos x)/x^2 -> 1/2 and/or the sinc limit.

exercises.technique: 0/0 at x=0. Factor sin x(1-cos x) from the numerator, then replace 1-cos x with the half-angle form 2sin^2(x/2). Split the expression into (sin x/x)·(2sin^2(x/2))/x^2 and apply the sinc limit twice.
